# ---- german ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part, then the
# standard-of-living gap over the core parts and the joined ones that pass their gates, with
# hysteresis: te_cm_sol_ok_german closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open.
te_cmg_census_german_country = {
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = north_german TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = south_german TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = alemannic TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = east_german TIER = 1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_german_north_german ?= 1
			te_cmg_german_north_german_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = german CULTURE = north_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_german_south_german ?= 1
			te_cmg_german_south_german_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = german CULTURE = south_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_german_alemannic ?= 1
			te_cmg_german_alemannic_available = yes
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = german CULTURE = alemannic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_german_east_german ?= 1
			te_cmg_german_east_german_available = yes
			global_var:te_cm_joined_german_east_german ?= 1
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = german CULTURE = east_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_german } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_german value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_german = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_german value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_german value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_german = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_german_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_german_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_german = {
			te_cmg_census_german_country = yes
		}
	}
}

				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part, then the
# standard-of-living gap over the core parts and the joined ones that pass their gates, with

	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_dutch_dutch ?= 1
			te_cmg_dutch_dutch_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = dutch CULTURE = dutch }

	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_nordestino ?= 1
			te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = nordestino }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_paulista ?= 1
			te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = paulista }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_amazonic ?= 1
			te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = amazonic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_sulista ?= 1
			te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = sulista }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
			te_cmg_brazilian_afro_brazilian_available = yes
			global_var:te_cm_joined_brazilian_afro_brazilian ?= 1
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = afro_brazilian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_brazilian = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_brazilian ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_brazilian_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_brazilian = {
			te_cmg_census_brazilian_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- platine ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part, then the
# standard-of-living gap over the core parts and the joined ones that pass their gates, with
# hysteresis: te_cm_sol_ok_platine closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open.
te_cmg_census_platine_country = {
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = platinean TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = argentine TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = uruguayan TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = paraguayan TIER = 1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_platine_platinean ?= 1
			te_cmg_platine_platinean_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = platinean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_platine_argentine ?= 1
			te_cmg_platine_argentine_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = argentine }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_platine_uruguayan ?= 1
			te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = uruguayan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_platine_paraguayan ?= 1
			te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = paraguayan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_platine } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_platine value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_platine = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_platine value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_platine value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- arab ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part, then the
# standard-of-living gap over the core parts and the joined ones that pass their gates, with
# hysteresis: te_cm_sol_ok_arab closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open.
te_cmg_census_arab_country = {
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = maghrebi TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = misri TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = mashriqi TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bedouin TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = yemenite TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = sudanese TIER = 2 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = haratin TIER = 2 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bidan TIER = 2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_arab_maghrebi ?= 1
			te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = maghrebi }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_arab_misri ?= 1
			te_cmg_arab_misri_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = misri }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_arab_mashriqi ?= 1

	}

		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_arab_bedouin ?= 1
			te_cmg_arab_bedouin_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bedouin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_arab_yemenite ?= 1
			te_cmg_arab_yemenite_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = yemenite }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_arab_sudanese ?= 1
			te_cmg_arab_sudanese_available = yes
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_sudanese ?= 1
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = sudanese }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_arab_haratin ?= 1
			te_cmg_arab_haratin_available = yes
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_haratin ?= 1
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = haratin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_arab_bidan ?= 1
			te_cmg_arab_bidan_available = yes
			global_var:te_cm_joined_arab_bidan ?= 1
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bidan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_arab } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_arab value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_arab value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_arab value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_arab = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_arab_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_arab_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_arab = {
			te_cmg_census_arab_country = yes
		}
	}
}

				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_filipino value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_filipino = {

# ---- nguni ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part, then the
# standard-of-living gap over the core parts and the joined ones that pass their gates, with
# hysteresis: te_cm_sol_ok_nguni closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open.
te_cmg_census_nguni_country = {
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = nguni TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = zulu TIER = 1 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = xhosa TIER = 1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_nguni_nguni ?= 1
			te_cmg_nguni_nguni_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = nguni }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_nguni_zulu ?= 1
			te_cmg_nguni_zulu_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = zulu }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_nguni_xhosa ?= 1
			te_cmg_nguni_xhosa_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = xhosa }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_nguni } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_nguni value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_nguni = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_nguni value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_nguni value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay = {
			te_cmg_census_pan_malay_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- east_african ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part, then the
# standard-of-living gap over the core parts and the joined ones that pass their gates, with
# hysteresis: te_cm_sol_ok_east_african closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open.
te_cmg_census_east_african_country = {
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = swahili TIER = 3 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = nyamwezi TIER = 3 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = sukuma TIER = 3 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = yao TIER = 3 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = makua TIER = 3 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = lacustrine_bantu TIER = 3 }
	te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = kikuyu TIER = 3 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_east_african_swahili ?= 1
			te_cmg_east_african_swahili_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = swahili }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_east_african_nyamwezi ?= 1
			te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = nyamwezi }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_east_african_sukuma ?= 1
			te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_available = yes
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = sukuma }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_east_african_yao ?= 1
			te_cmg_east_african_yao_available = yes
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_yao ?= 1
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = yao }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_east_african_makua ?= 1
			te_cmg_east_african_makua_available = yes
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_makua ?= 1
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = makua }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_east_african_lacustrine_bantu ?= 1
			te_cmg_east_african_lacustrine_bantu_available = yes
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_lacustrine_bantu ?= 1
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = lacustrine_bantu }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_cm_ok_east_african_kikuyu ?= 1
			te_cmg_east_african_kikuyu_available = yes
			global_var:te_cm_joined_east_african_kikuyu ?= 1
		}
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = kikuyu }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_african = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_east_african = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_east_african_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_east_african_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african = {
			te_cmg_census_east_african_country = yes
		}
	}
}
